measure: Time from suspicious message to employee report
target: Under 15 minutes in a controlled drill
collection_method: Consent-based timestamp comparison in future exercise
misinterpretation_guard: No synthetic 6-minute employee report can be treated as a measured workforce median

measure: Correct first-response selection on knowledge checks
target: At least 7 of 8 questions correctly answered
misinterpretation_guard: No real learners or quiz completion recorded
Sample cannot be generalized without coverage assessment

collection_method: Validated identity event and post-revocation test timestamps
misinterpretation_guard: Proposed response events are not actual token revocations

measure: Quality of uncertainty statements in incident updates
target: All exercise updates distinguish observed and inferred facts
misinterpretation_guard: Creating message templates does not measure staff performance
Action assignment and training attendance alone cannot prove effectiveness
